title: Ibne Hyder Alweda shahe besar alweda
body:
Ibne Hyder Alvida
Shah E Besar Alvida
Rahat E Rooh E Ali, Jaan E Payamber Alvida
Noor E Aain E Fatima, Fidya E Dawar Alvida
1. Aye Alamdar E Hussain Waye Madadgar E Hussain
Aa'ah Abbas E Ali Saniye Jaffer Alvida
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Be Pidar Gar Dida Dar Karbobala Binte Hussain
Aye Sitam Deda Yateem E Shah E Besar Alvida
